import numpy as np
import cvxpy as cp

# Scenario 1: Same 3-variable problem but W=cp.bmat([[x[0],x[2]],[x[1],1.0]]) with alpha=np.array([[0.2,0.4],[0.8,0.6]]) used as-is, PowConeND(W,hypos,alpha,axis=1)
try:
    x = cp.Variable(3)
    hypos = cp.Variable(2)
    W = cp.bmat([[x[0], x[2]], [x[1], 1.0]])
    alpha = np.array([[0.2, 0.4], [0.8, 0.6]])
    
    objective = cp.Maximize(cp.sum(hypos) - x[0])
    constraints = [cp.PowConeND(W, hypos, alpha, axis=1)]
    prob = cp.Problem(objective, constraints)
    prob.solve(solver=cp.CLARABEL)
    
    probe("Same 3-variable problem but W=cp.bmat([[x[0],x[2]],[x[1],1.0]]) with alpha=np.array([[0.2,0.4],[0.8,0.6]]) used as-is, PowConeND(W,hypos,alpha,axis=1) (W and alpha left untransposed for axis=1 case of test_pow_cone_nd_3d).", prob.value)

    probe_exception("Same 3-variable problem but W=cp.bmat([[x[0],x[2]],[x[1],1.0]]) with alpha=np.array([[0.2,0.4],[0.8,0.6]]) used as-is, PowConeND(W,hypos,alpha,axis=1) (W and alpha left untransposed for axis=1 case of test_pow_cone_nd_3d).", e)
